arguments.sql:
SELECT p.publisher_name, a.alignment, COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(s.full_name) AS nonnull_names,
       COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(s.full_name), '')) AS nonblank_names,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(s.full_name) = '-' THEN 1 END) AS dashes,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(s.full_name) = s.superhero_name THEN 1 END) AS same_as_hero_name
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN main.alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name LIKE '%Marvel%'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name, a.alignment
ORDER BY p.publisher_name, a.alignment
